channel.title: somewhere.lat
channel.description: Trip-planning guides to Latin America's great journeys: Machu Picchu, Patagonia, Oaxaca, Cartagena, Costa Rica and more. Itineraries, tickets, seasons and costs.

item.title: How to plan a trip to Machu Picchu
item.description: Tickets, circuits, trains, the Inca Trail and altitude: everything to sort out before you go to Machu Picchu.

item.title: Iguazú Falls: how to see both the Argentine and Brazilian sides
item.description: How many days to spend at Iguazú Falls, the Argentine vs Brazilian side, the Devil's Throat, boat rides, border tips and when to go.

item.title: Cusco and the Sacred Valley: how to spend 4 days before Machu Picchu
item.description: What to see in Cusco and the Sacred Valley, the tourist ticket, how to handle the altitude, and how it all connects to the Machu Picchu train.

item.title: Cartagena, Colombia: the walled city and the islands
item.description: Where to stay in Cartagena, what to do in the old town and how to plan a day trip to the Rosario Islands.

item.title: Costa Rica for first-timers: a 10-day route
item.description: Arenal, Monteverde and the Pacific coast in ten days, plus seasons, park tickets and getting around Costa Rica.

item.title: Oaxaca travel guide: food, mezcal and Day of the Dead
item.description: When to visit Oaxaca, the best day trips, what to eat and how to experience Día de Muertos respectfully.

item.title: Torres del Paine and the W Trek: a planning guide
item.description: When to go, how to book campsites and refugios, and how to get to Torres del Paine in Chilean Patagonia.
